description: O72/O98 Quark Drive and Booster Energy at the battle start: Tapu Koko's Electric Surge gives Iron Hands and Iron Valiant Quark Drive (Attack); Flutter Mane (Protosynthesis, no sun) uses its Booster Energy (fromBooster) with Speed as its best stat (156 > 155 SpA), so its Speed is 1.5x (234) and its Harden comes before Tapu Koko's (182) Wild Charge. Iron Hands's boosted Strength hits Iron Valiant.
